response.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT rfistat, AVG(modindex) AS avg_mod FROM signals WHERE modindex IS NOT NULL GROUP BY rfistat), o AS (SELECT AVG(modindex) AS overall_avg FROM signals WHERE modindex IS NOT NULL), q AS (SELECT g.rfistat, g.avg_mod, o.overall_avg FROM g CROSS JOIN o WHERE g.avg_mod > o.overall_avg) SELECT rfistat, avg_mod AS avg_modindex, avg_mod - overall_avg AS diff_above_overall_avg, avg_mod - (SELECT AVG(avg_mod) FROM q) AS diff_from_qualifying_mean FROM q
